title: Silver futures decline to ₹2.43 lakh/kg - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Silver prices on Thursday fell by ₹568 to ₹2,43,645 per kilogram in futures trade as participants reduced their bets.

On the Multi Commodity Exchange, silver contracts for December delivery declined by ₹568, or 0.23 per cent, to ₹2,43,645 per kg in a business turnover of 1,262 lots.

Analysts said a sell-off by participants mainly weighed on silver prices.

Globally, the white metal was trading 0.50 per cent higher at $67.63 per ounce in New York.
